title: Are Short-Selling Restrictions Effective?
authors: Yashar H. Barardehi; Andrew Bird; Stephen A. Karolyi; THOMAS G. RUCHTI
eligible_reason: Regression discontinuity around the -10% intraday return threshold that triggers SEC Rule 201 short-sale restrictions (2% bandwidth; placebo cutoffs), stock-day level. No DiD or staggered-adoption design. Only mock-up data for three masked stocks are shipped; TAQ/CRSP/Compustat are licensed.
design_notes: Estimation.do: RDD regressions of post-trigger outcomes (returns, seller-initiated volume, volatility, spreads, depth) on treatment_10 and runret10 within a 2% bandwidth (Tables 4 and 10).
data_files: MockUp/Data/* (sample data for three stocks with masked identities)
data_files_note: Read_me.pdf: data built from WRDS (CRSP, TAQ, Compustat); MockUp folder illustrates the data structure using three masked stocks.
data_provenance_note: Mock-up extract for three masked stocks only; analysis data not shipped.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2024.4987.txt); 'event study' mentions refer to prior literature.
